The farm can be expanded from experience level 22 and up by unlocking farm plots. Players need the same number of land deeds, mallets and marker stakes to unlock one plot but this number may vary from one plot to another.

Expansions are in two locations: the main one is on the side of the farmhouse; the second one is across the main road.

The second location also has special plots with exclusive decorations. Unlocking these requires expansion permits, which are unlocked at level 29.

All plots can be unlocked starting at the top. Once a section has been unlocked all adjacent ones become unlockable.

See the maps and tables below to know how many objects are needed for each plot.
